propositions: A dedicated executor client must be constructed with max_retries=0 and reject nonzero session values, while preserving legacy client construction

Each write invocation must issue exactly GET/PUT/GET in sequence, with initial GET faults classified as retryable or permanent, PUT faults ending with commit_unknown and request_count=2 without read-back, and successful PUT triggering authoritative read-back GET

After ambiguous PUT, a separate single-attempt GET observation must be mapped through decide_replay: observed summary matching intended value yields recovered outcome; mismatch or missing observed summary permits replay within remaining budget; GET failure returns non-replaying commit_unknown
Injected one-attempt/no-sleep policy for selected executor calls must preserve legacy wrapper defaults and behavior

Every DC terminal or exhausted outcome must emit exactly one completion log containing only logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one redacted message capped at 512 Unicode code points, with whole log at most 1,024 Unicode code points
